title: Best time
text: Very informative and fun! Tour guide was excellent. Definitely a good deal  in Barcelona. 5 stars.  Super accommodating
author: Susan_Z

title: Great Segway Tour and a great way to hit the highlights
text: Our guide, Kadyrberri, was fabulous! He was fun, knowledgeable, and gave us some much great information on the sights. There’s no way to see everything. We saw by walking, and the segways kept us out of the heavy traffic. We had never ridden a Segway but we picked it right up and then hit the highlights of Barcelona. I would definitely recommend it and our guide!
author: maryalycec2022

title: A fun way to see beautiful Barcelona
text: I had a fantastic small group tour with Carlos on Sunday. After everyone had the time they needed to get safety training and used to the controls of maneuvering the segway, we set off. Carlos was a great guide, very upbeat and fun with an incredible knowledge of the history of Barcelona. Some tourist areas were very busy as to be expected, such as the Sagrada Familia, but we got through just fine at a slower pace, whereas we could go at a greater speed in some park areas and in the cycle lanes. title: Fun way to see the sites
text: Highly recommend! Natasha was an excellent guide. She provided history, sites and fun facts on this lovely city. Don't hesitate. Take this tour!
author: Maurine_E

title: Good value tour
text: Phil was a great guide, really informative and answered all of our questions about Barcelona and living there. We’ve used segways before so we were up and out in no time.
author: Flewsy

title: Must do activity for BCN
text: We arrived BCN on the date with massive rallies.  Most of the shops incl the St Joseph Marker was closed.  Lucky that we have joined this tour.  Our tour guide Elisa has done an excellent job in redesign our tour route map in order to get away from the crowd and still able to see the Gaudi attractions.  Elisa not only provide good information of history of these attractions, she also took many great pictures for us.  This tour is unforgettable and I truly recommend visitors to join this tour.
author: 138bernardl

title: excellent tour
text: The Segway Gaudí Tour with Ilaria was a fabulous experience for both my 15-year-old son and myself. Ilaria excellent guide, prepared, not boring. the segway tour is fun, youthful, a quick way to see Gaudi's main attractions, I would do it again and would absolutely recommend
